measures.title: Citywide one-half percent sales tax for street infrastructure maintenance
measures.summary: Asks whether the City of Manhattan may levy an additional one-half percent (0.5%) citywide retailers' sales tax for street infrastructure maintenance under K.S.A. 12-187. The tax would take effect April 1, 2027, the day after the existing special-purpose citywide sales tax that took effect April 1, 2017 expires, or as soon after as the law allows, and would expire 10 years later.
measures.yesMeans: The city may levy the 0.5% sales tax for street maintenance for 10 years starting in 2027.
measures.noMeans: The city may not levy this 0.5% sales tax.
